item.title: Ultimate Security Add-On
item.creator: CHRONICOVERRIDE LLC
item.description: Fortify your survival world with biometric locks, keycards, PIN pads, drones, cameras, sensors, safes, and powerful turrets. Create custom access levels, track intruders, and build a fully automated defense network. This Add-On brings high tech protection to your worlds.
item.howToTitle: How to Use the Ultimate Security Add-On

howToEntries.content:
HOW TO USE:

1. Fixed Position Camera
   Surveillance camera used to view the area where it is placed. Place it facing the desired direction, then place a Monitor nearby. Interact with the Monitor, select a nearby camera, and view through it. Move your character to disconnect.

2. Monitor
   Control station for Fixed Position Cameras. Interact to view nearby cameras, then select one to connect.

3. Security Door
   Configurable door with Basic, Advanced, or Admin access. Basic and Advanced support PIN access; Admin requires the unique Admin Keycard. Owners can interact without a Keycard to configure settings. Non-owners need a valid Keycard to open or close it.

4. Biometric Security
   Scans the nearest player's biometrics. If the recorded data matches, Security Doors in Basic or Advanced mode will open. Interact to configure and record the owner's biometrics.

5. Keycards
   Available in three colors representing different access levels. Create and link Keycards through the Security Door interface, then hold the correct Keycard and interact with the door to open it.

6. Pin Pad
   Used with Security Doors that have a numeric PIN. Enter the correct PIN to open the door.

7. Motion Sensor
   Detects movement within a 12-block radius and emits a redstone signal when a player or mob enters its detection zone. Connect it to redstone devices you want triggered by motion.

8. Laser Sensor
   Creates a beam between two Laser Sensors facing each other. Place them at a reasonable distance with no obstructions. Crossing the beam emits a redstone signal and damages the entity.

9. Turret
   Autonomous defense unit that targets nearby hostile mobs when placed and powered.
   Fast Mode: 2 HP per second, 1 projectile per second, fast rotation.
   Slow Mode: 12 HP every 3 seconds, 1 projectile every 3 seconds, slower rotation.

10. Drone
    Follow Mode: Flies slightly above and behind the player, casting light ahead.
    Patrol Mode: Links to a Turret and patrols for mobs. It illuminates detected mobs and greatly expands the Turret's targeting radius.

11. Safe
    Secure, indestructible storage that can only be accessed by the player who placed it. Sneak and interact to access settings or pick it up.
